items.title: James Moody — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Todd Coolman, my good -- yeah, I like so many guys.

ctx.x: You know. But I -- I like to listen to all -- all the guys, you know. You know like [indiscernible] Randy, you know, Tom Howell [phonetic sp.], John [indiscernible], Joe Henderson [phonetic sp.], Howell Land [phonetic sp.]. You know. Dick Oat [phonetic sp.] -­ Joe Levano [indiscernible]. You know. You know. [indiscernible] Miller, you know, Mark Copeland [phonetic sp.], Todd Coolman, my good -- yeah, I like so many guys. I mean, many, many musicians. And that's another thing, so many musicians, good musicians…
